entry.title: nebius: sync catalog with Token Factory, remove deprecated models (#5…
entry.content:
nebius: sync catalog with Token Factory, remove deprecated models (#5802)

* nebius: sync catalog with Token Factory, remove deprecated models

- Update context limits from the Token Factory models list
  (GLM-5.2 and DeepSeek-V4-Pro to 1M, Qwen3-30B to 262K, gpt-oss-120b /
  Hermes-4-405B to 131072, embedding model to 40960)
- Add DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731, Kimi-K2.6, Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b,
  Nemotron-3_5-Lightning, GLM-5.1, GLM-5.3-Flash
- Remove deprecated and superseded endpoints (V3.2, K2.5, M2.5,
  fast variants, GLM-5, INTELLECT-3, Nano/Omni/253B, Qwen2.5-VL,
  Qwen3-32B, Qwen3-Next-80B, V4-Flash, Hermes-4-70B, Llama-3.3-70B)

* chore(sync): update OpenRouter model catalog (#5801)

Co-authored-by: opencode-agent[bot] <opencode-agent[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

* nebius: address review feedback on reasoning options and limits

- Nemotron-3-Ultra / 3.5-Lightning: replace empty reasoning_options with the
  host chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking toggle; raise limit.output to the
  1M served window
- GLM-5.3-Flash: effort values low|high|max per lab (no invented medium);
  document text-only serving and source URLs
- Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507: align limit.input (262_144) with the new 262K context
- Drop Nebius Kimi-K2.6 and GLM-5.1 entries

* nebius: verify reasoning controls and limits live against Token Factory

- Nemotron-3-Ultra / 3.5-Lightning: replace unverified chat_template_kwargs
  toggle with the host-documented reasoning_effort control (probed live:
  none disables thinking; the enable_thinking kwarg is forwarded but
  undocumented); keep limits at the served 1M max_model_len
- DeepSeek-V4-Pro: raise limit.output to the served 1_048_576 window; effort
  none|low|high|max verified live (max distinctly heavier; mid tiers flat;
  thinking.type inert on this host)
- DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731: document intentional 1_024_000 per-model
  max_model_len

* updated model cards according to spec requirements

* nebius: document Nemotron reasoning toggle

* nebius: inherit Nemotron Lightning description

* nebius: model Nemotron reasoning as effort

---------

entry.title: chore(berget): remove deprecated models, add Qwen3.8-27B (#5985)
entry.content:
chore(berget): remove deprecated models, add Qwen3.8-27B (#5985)

* chore(berget): remove deprecated models, add Qwen3.8-27B

Sync berget provider with https://api.berget.ai/v1/models.

Removed (deprecated in API or absent from catalog):
- openai/gpt-oss-120b (lifecycle_state=deprecated, EOL 2026-09-11)
- zai-org/GLM-4.7 (lifecycle_state=deprecated, EOL 2026-09-04)
- meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct (lifecycle_state=deprecated)
- zai-org/GLM-5.3 (not in /v1/models; only GLM-5.3-Flash remains)
- mistralai/Mistral-Medium-3.5-128B (not in /v1/models)
- moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6 (not in /v1/models; superseded by Kimi-K3)

Added:
- Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 (lifecycle_state=eval, vision=true)

Prices converted from EUR to USD at ECB rate 1.1596 (2026-08-31).
Validated with `bun validate`.

* fix(berget): drop inherited fields from Qwen3.8-27B override

Keep only real deltas from the lab entry: limit.output (65_536 vs lab
32_768) and modalities.input (text+image, no video). Drop context
(matches lab) and modalities.output (matches lab).

* fix(berget): raise GLM-5.3-Flash context to 512K

Needle-validated to 512K on the Berget B300 deployment.
